desc:
What is the SHIV?
The SHIV 9mm suppressor is a small, lightweight solution engineered for exceptional performance with 9mm pistols and pistol-caliber-carbines. Made with premium 3D-printed Grade 5 (ELI) Titanium, the SHIV weighs just 2.5 oz. It offers durability and excellent sound suppression while maintaining semi-auto pistol function. The low weight and short length eliminate the need for a booster on most 9mm pistols.

Why Choose the SHIV?
The SHIV 9mm suppressor combines our signature creative engineering and advanced 3D printing to deliver a lightweight yet robust suppressor. It eliminates the complexity of a booster system, offering a compact design that pushes the limits of performance, mass, and weight.

Reliable cycling on pistols depends not only on the suppressor’s mass but also on the location of its center of mass. We have carefully engineered the SHIV to provide the best possible balance of sound performance and reliability on semi-auto pistols.

Specifications

Caliber: 9mm, .38 Special, .357 Magnum, 300 Blackout Subsonic, 5.7×28 (compatible with all pistol calibers smaller in diameter than 9mm)

Weight: 2.5 oz

Length: 3.7 inches

Diameter: 1.3 inches

Material: Grade 5 (ELI) Titanium

Finish: Cerakote

Attachment: Direct thread (1/2×28)

Schedule of Fire: Full auto rated for 9mm, FRT-approved suppressor
